title: Revision of Household Income Eligibility Criteria for Disabled Persons Scheme Given Rising Cost of Living
what_it_is: Revision of Household Income Eligibility Criteria for Disabled Persons Scheme Given Rising Cost of Living

sections.label: DPS and TSS income criteria
sections.summary: The DPS income criteria were last revised in 2017, and in 2020 the TSS qualifying monthly per capita household income rose from $2,600 to $2,800.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The household income eligibility criteria for the DPS were last reviewed and revised in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As we move towards being a car-lite society, we have enhanced the Taxi Subsidy Scheme (TSS) to cater to persons with disabilities who are unable to take public transport.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The TSS provides means-tested subsidies to defray the cost of travel via taxis and private hire vehicles to school, work or employment-related training.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In 2020, the Ministry of Social and Family Development increased the TSS qualifying monthly per capita household income from $2,600 to $2,800.

sections.label: Private transport operators for disabilities
sections.summary: Private transport operators for persons with disabilities have entered the market, and the transport landscape will be monitored and reviewed for accessibility and affordability.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Several private transport operators catering to persons with disabilities have also entered the market, further enhancing the overall accessibility.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor and review the transport landscape for persons with disabilities to ensure that transport options remain accessible and affordable.

sections.label: Family situations and affordability reviews
sections.summary: The situation and factors within each family are considered holistically, and affordability and accessibility are reviewed from time to time, though exact numbers were not available.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Actually, to both questions, the short answer is yes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: First one, we do consider, holistically, the situation and factors within each family.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: On the second question about numbers, I do not have the exact numbers; but we do review, as I mentioned in my main reply, the affordability and accessibility from time to time.
